customerOutcome: See active and recently completed work and open its native Task, Project or Routine owner.
entryConditions: Current authenticated principal and company selection; no retained foreign-principal payload
Effective feature admission is required for new work; native membership and resource authority remain necessary
exitConditions: Only a canonical server-confirmed result permits a success claim
Pending, stale, unavailable or unqualified work never becomes successful or activated

content.supportingCopy: See active and recently completed work and open its native Task, Project or Routine owner.
displayedState: Authorized bounded active and recent completed Task projections
Tasks, Projects and Routines open their existing native owners
Unavailable dependency does not imply an empty company; an empty bounded view does not imply no work

primary.label: Ask August
primary.operation: Open the governed native command entry; this page does not execute a model or create work.

secondary: Open exact active Task or completed result

canonicalReadDomains: Existing native authorized Tasks and the current principal/company experience projection
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: None; each native owner retains writes, versions, permission checks and history.
systemWork.authorityEffect: Presentation and drafts cannot grant permissions. Material effects always require current native permissions, approvals and version preconditions.
systemWork.asyncWork: Native reads/mutations only; projection work uses bounded admission and a 1500 ms total deadline. Unknown mutation outcomes retain the original request key for reconciliation.
systemWork.receipt: Current Task/status version and observation only; no new run or qualified artifact is fabricated.

states.loading: Announce loading while current identity or native read authorization is being checked; hide retained cards and controls during the check.
states.empty: Explain an actual empty authorized result. Missing dependencies or qualified capabilities are separate unavailable states.
states.partial: Retain trustworthy available results and name unavailable dependencies or sources.
states.stale: Suppress retained cards after native access/source loss; a company/principal-scoped query epoch rejects late old receipts. Changed sources are partial, never a complete empty queue.
states.validation_error: Preserve other entered values, identify the field problem and associate it programmatically with the control.
states.system_error: Explain that the operation is unconfirmed, preserve entered data, and offer a valid retry/refresh or support route.
states.permission_denied: Suppress retained private data and unavailable controls; do not infer additional grants from profile or navigation.
states.recovering: Re-resolve canonical state/version and the original request identity before permitting another effect.
states.success: Announce only the server-confirmed canonical result. First value additionally requires independently verified native artifact/run binding.

navigation.back: Browser and product Back preserve session form state without recreating organizations, agents or runs.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: No input is written to browser persistent storage; committed activation drafts remain in the native onboarding owner.
navigation.resume: Re-read current company/principal. Existing expert task and work deep links remain compatible.

accessibility.initialFocus: Main heading or the dialog category control; keyboard focus is visible and unobscured.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Error summary or first invalid control, with a programmatically associated explanation.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Canonical receipt or next-step heading; announcements do not trap focus.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard buttons, links, labeled text inputs and semantic single-select controls; dialog Escape/close and focus return use the native primitive.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.

dataShown: Feedback original text and visible messages only in private customer history
dataCollected: Only explicit fields and the published safe-context allowlist
sensitiveFields: Raw intent, company facts, feedback and results remain customer data
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: Exclude customer prose, prompts, result bodies, attachments and raw errors from generic analytics/activity details; native domain audit is purpose-separated.

functional: Verify native company-prefixed owner links, exact Task bindings, truthful bounded empty state and independent dependency failure.
Full durable Project/outcome and Routine composition, work takeover and representative journey qualification remain open.
accessibility: Verify keyboard/focus/announcements and 200/400% zoom manually on the exact artifact.
securityPrivacy: Verify current membership/resource revocation, tenant isolation, untrusted content and separate private feedback identity purpose.
Reject foreign company receipts and late old-epoch responses; verify native Task/Attention/grant/flag changes during bounded fan-out.
usability: Use representative exploratory and pre-registered confirmatory journey evidence with explicit PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; source checks are insufficient.
